title.zh: 派凯柏 · 火底转圈与续喷交棒
title.en: Piper / Caesar / Burnice · Fire-first spins and spray handoff

summary.zh: 凯撒按需补盾，柏建立火异常与余烬条件，派派用真实满蓄EX打强击；柏Q快支只在提示出现时合轴。
summary.en: Caesar refreshes shields as needed, Burnice establishes Fire/Afterburn, and Piper uses a legally charged EX for Assault. Burnice Ultimate overlaps only through an actual assist prompt.

conditions.zh: 循环站位凯撒→柏妮思→派派，整体旋转等价；柏Q的下一位快支接派派。
conditions.en: Cyclic order Caesar→Burnice→Piper; rotations are equivalent. Burnice Ultimate assists Piper next.

conditions.zh: 采用作者1.2明确的简→派派替换，并交叉当前基础技能；不包含柏妮思潜能流火。
conditions.en: Uses the author’s explicit 1.2 Jane→Piper replacement, checked against current base skills; excludes Burnice Potential awakening.

conditions.zh: 教学适用于固定Gachabase正式3.3基础技能；默认0影无专武，不启用潜能觉醒。
conditions.en: Uses fixed Gachabase release 3.3 base skills; M0 without signatures by default, with no Potential awakening.

conditions.zh: 按实际资源、敌人异常、失衡与提示执行；没有固定秒数、帧数、连携次数或最高分承诺。
conditions.en: Follow actual resources, Anomaly, Stun and prompts; no fixed seconds, frames, Chain count or maximum-score claim.

label.zh: 小橙子 · 柏妮思物火队与派派替换（1.2）
label.en: Orange · Burnice Physical/Fire team and Piper replacement (1.2)

label.zh: 凯撒 · 固定 Gachabase 3.3
label.en: Caesar · fixed Gachabase 3.3

label.zh: 柏妮思 · 固定 Gachabase 3.3
label.en: Burnice · fixed Gachabase 3.3

label.zh: 派派 · 固定 Gachabase 3.3
label.en: Piper · fixed Gachabase 3.3

label.zh: 开局
label.en: Opening

objective.zh: 盾与火底准备后，合法升档转EX。
objective.en: Prepare shield/Fire, then legally charge into EX.

title.en: Refresh Caesar EX only when the shield needs it

input.zh: 普通切凯撒；能量足够时点按EX。
input.en: Switch normally to Caesar; tap EX when energy permits.

trigger.zh: 盾已破、将结束或开局尚无盾；不要求敌人每次都攻击。
trigger.en: The shield is absent, expiring or broken; an enemy attack is not required for the base shield.

complete.zh: 发动招架反击生成荣光之盾，再普通切柏妮思。
complete.en: Parry Counter activation creates Radiant Aegis; then switch normally to Burnice.

reason.zh: 普通EX可加盾，但附近敌人的额外易伤需真实精准格挡、反击、招架或对应长普触发。
reason.en: Base EX grants the shield; the separate nearby-enemy debuff needs an actual Perfect Block, Retaliation, Defensive Assist or the specified held Basic.

fallback.zh: 没能量先正常回能并躲避；盾覆盖足够就省略EX，仍切到柏执行需要的补火。
fallback.en: Without energy, recover normally and dodge. If shield coverage suffices, skip EX but still switch to Burnice for needed Fire setup.

signal.zh: 盾已确认或无需刷新后，普通切柏妮思。
signal.en: After confirming or retaining the shield, switch normally to Burnice.

title.zh: 柏长普挂灼伤、建立火底
title.en: Burnice held Basic establishes Scorched and Fire buildup

input.zh: 燃油特调中长按普攻，等终结一击；需要补火且有能量再接下一步双喷。
input.en: In Nitro-Fuel, hold Basic and finish its final hit; use the next double-nozzle step only when Fire needs more buildup and energy permits.

trigger.zh: 燃油特调已激活；基础开战有100燃点，但应读取当前库存。
trigger.en: Nitro-Fuel is active; baseline battle entry grants 100 Heat, but check the current stock.

complete.zh: 发动消耗20燃点；合法命中挂灼伤。灼伤标记不等于灼烧异常，火底以实际异常为准。
complete.en: Activation spends 20 Heat; a qualifying hit applies Scorched. Scorched is not the Burn Anomaly; read the actual target state.

reason.zh: 补足后及时交派派，不把后台余烬算作无限输出。
reason.en: Hand back to Piper once ready; off-field Afterburn is not unlimited.

fallback.zh: 缺能量但特调仍在，可用合法长普补标记；特调已断则先普攻回能，不能空按长普冒充强化动作。
fallback.en: If energy is short but Nitro-Fuel remains, a legal held Basic can restore the mark. If Nitro-Fuel ended, recover with normal Basics; do not invent the enhanced held attack.

title.zh: 有需要才接双喷，然后交派派
title.en: Double-nozzle only if needed, then hand to Piper

input.zh: 长普终结一击后，有能量点按EX接双喷；按需要保持长按。
input.en: After the held-Basic finisher, press EX with enough energy for double-nozzle; hold only as needed.

trigger.zh: 已完成合法入口，火异常或燃点还需补充。
trigger.en: The legal entry finished and Fire buildup or Heat needs replenishing.

complete.zh: 确认实际灼烧／火积蓄与燃点，再普通切派派。
complete.en: Read actual Burn/Fire buildup and Heat, then switch normally to Piper.

reason.zh: 作者建议火异常先作底，派派再用物理结算；无法保证每次固定双喷都爆条。
reason.en: The author recommends Fire first, then Piper Physical; a fixed double-nozzle duration cannot guarantee an Anomaly.

fallback.zh: 资源已够可省略双喷，但仍普通切派派；未接长普终结／合法入口时改用单喷起手，不能直接双喷。
fallback.en: Skip double-nozzle if ready, but still switch normally to Piper. Without a held-Basic finisher or another legal entry, start from single-nozzle rather than inventing direct double-nozzle.

signal.zh: 火底／资源够用后普通切派派。
signal.en: Switch normally to Piper once Fire/setup suffices.

title.zh: 先让轮胎转达到最高蓄力
title.en: Bring Tire Spin to maximum charge first

input.zh: 先打普攻前三段中的合法衔接段，再长按特殊技；观察旋转蓄力提升。
input.en: Use a legal link after one of the first three Basic stages, then hold Special and observe the spin charge.

trigger.zh: 派派已在前场，准备发动引擎转；不把快支或连携当作满蓄力入口。
trigger.en: Piper is active and preparing Engine Spin; Quick Assist or Chain alone is not a maximum-charge entry.

complete.zh: 轮胎转达到最高蓄力且能量足够，才继续按住转EX。
complete.en: Only continue into EX once Tire Spin is at maximum charge and energy is sufficient.

reason.zh: 普攻衔接提高起始蓄力，但不是每段都瞬间满；0影普通轮胎转不按核心直接叠动力。
reason.en: The Basic link raises starting charge, but does not make every stage instantly maximum. At M0, normal Tire Spin does not grant core Power stacks.

fallback.zh: 无能量先普攻回能，危险时松手／闪避；不要把普通转圈算作EX或免伤无敌。
fallback.en: Without energy, recover with Basics. Release/dodge danger; normal spinning is neither EX nor full invulnerability.

label.zh: 余烬 · 燃油特调仍在、有燃点且队友实际命中灼伤目标时触发
label.en: Afterburn · requires Nitro-Fuel, Heat and an ally hitting a Scorched target

label.zh: 荣光之盾 · 攻击增益给当前护盾持有者，按实际盾量与持续时间
label.en: Radiant Aegis · ATK buff follows the current shield holder; check actual shield and duration

title.en: Land Engine Spin and read Power

input.zh: 轮胎转最高蓄力且能量足够时继续长按EX，贴住可命中的目标。
input.en: At maximum Tire Spin charge with enough energy, keep holding EX against a hittable target.

trigger.zh: 合法满蓄入口、实有能量、目标处于攻击范围。
trigger.en: A legal full-charge entry, real energy and a target in reach.

complete.zh: EX旋转命中逐次叠动力；达到20才有本队团队增伤，灼烧目标上触发强击才按实际结算紊乱。
complete.en: EX spin hits build Power; the team buff needs 20 stacks. Assault on a Burning target resolves the actual Disorder.

reason.zh: 旋转持续耗能，基础上限3秒，6影才延长；不能把每次旋转都算一轮强击。
reason.en: Spinning spends energy continuously, with a baseline three-second cap extended only at M6; each spin is not automatically an Assault.

fallback.zh: 火底不在就看当前异常继续积蓄或回柏补火；能量不足提前收尾，别硬等满时长。
fallback.en: If Burn is absent, work from the current Anomaly or restore Fire with Burnice. Finish early when energy is low.

label.zh: 余烬 · 燃油特调仍在、有燃点且队友实际命中灼伤目标时触发
label.en: Afterburn · requires Nitro-Fuel, Heat and an ally hitting a Scorched target

label.zh: 荣光之盾 · 攻击增益给当前护盾持有者，按实际盾量与持续时间
label.en: Radiant Aegis · ATK buff follows the current shield holder; check actual shield and duration

title.zh: 松开EX收下砸，决定是否回补
title.en: Release EX for the slam, then assess recovery

input.zh: 引擎转中松开EX；时长到顶或能量降至20也会自动发动。
input.en: Release EX during Engine Spin; it also triggers automatically at its time limit or when energy drops to 20.

trigger.zh: 已经处于引擎转；普通轮胎转松手是另一招。
trigger.en: Engine Spin is active; releasing normal Tire Spin is a different move.

complete.zh: 确认非常重下砸完成，读取剩余动力、能量、燃点与盾。
complete.en: Confirm Really Heavy finishes, then read Power, energy, Heat and the shield.

reason.zh: 有资源继续派派；燃点或盾不足才切辅助，避免固定循环挤掉可用输出。
reason.en: Stay on Piper while resources last; only refresh missing Heat/shield rather than forcing unnecessary swaps.

fallback.zh: 已经自动下砸不要重复输入；若只有普通轮胎转，按普通收尾处理后重新准备EX。
fallback.en: Do not repeat an already automatic slam. If only normal Tire Spin was active, finish it normally and prepare EX again.

label.zh: 余烬 · 燃油特调仍在、有燃点且队友实际命中灼伤目标时触发
label.en: Afterburn · requires Nitro-Fuel, Heat and an ally hitting a Scorched target

label.zh: 荣光之盾 · 攻击增益给当前护盾持有者，按实际盾量与持续时间
label.en: Radiant Aegis · ATK buff follows the current shield holder; check actual shield and duration

prep.zh: 有燃点不等于EX能量充足；先按实际资源执行，缺能量正常积蓄。
prep.en: Heat does not equal EX energy; use actual resources and recover missing energy normally.

label.zh: 常态循环
label.en: Regular loop

objective.zh: 只补缺的盾和燃点，让派派持续接有效旋转。
objective.en: Refill only missing shield/Heat, keeping Piper’s legal spins active.

fallback.zh: 没能量先正常回能并躲避；盾覆盖足够就省略EX，仍切到柏执行需要的补火。

signal.zh: 盾已确认或无需刷新后，普通切柏妮思。
signal.en: After confirming or retaining the shield, switch normally to Burnice.

input.zh: 有能量时点按／长按EX单喷，按燃点与实际火异常停手。
input.en: With energy, tap/hold single-nozzle EX, stopping according to actual Heat and Fire Anomaly.

trigger.zh: 燃点偏低、特调耗尽或目标换了。
trigger.en: Heat is low, Nitro-Fuel expired, or the target changed.

complete.zh: 耗能恢复燃点；耗尽后需重新达到50才开启特调，合法攻击命中再挂灼伤。随后普通切派派。
complete.en: Energy spending restores Heat; after depletion, reach 50 to reactivate Nitro-Fuel and land a qualifying hit for Scorched. Then switch normally to Piper.

reason.zh: 补足后及时交派派，不把后台余烬算作无限输出。
reason.en: Hand back to Piper once ready; off-field Afterburn is not unlimited.

fallback.zh: 缺能量但特调仍在，可用合法长普补标记；特调已断则先普攻回能，不能空按长普冒充强化动作。
fallback.en: If energy is short but Nitro-Fuel remains, a legal held Basic can restore the mark. If Nitro-Fuel ended, recover with normal Basics; do not invent the enhanced held attack.

signal.zh: 燃点和标记恢复后普通切派派；省略补喷也要完成换人。
signal.en: Switch normally to Piper once Heat/mark recover; skipping the refill still requires the handoff.

title.en: Bring Tire Spin to maximum charge first

label.zh: 荣光之盾 · 攻击增益给当前护盾持有者，按实际盾量与持续时间
label.en: Radiant Aegis · ATK buff follows the current shield holder; check actual shield and duration

prep.zh: 盾、燃点与灼伤都足够时省略前两步，留派派；已切到辅助则按交棒回派派。
prep.en: Skip the first two events and stay on Piper when shield, Heat and Scorched suffice; if already on a support, complete the handoff back.

label.zh: 爆发窗口
label.en: Burst window

objective.zh: 用就绪的大招与快支延长有效输出。
objective.en: Use ready Ultimates and the actual assist to extend useful damage.

title.zh: 柏Q就绪时打开双人输出窗口
title.en: Use Burnice’s ready Ultimate for a shared attack window

input.zh: 普通切柏；她自己的Q就绪时释放，跳起出现派派快支提示再响应。
input.en: Switch normally to Burnice; use her own ready Ultimate and respond when Piper’s Quick Assist appears during the leap.

trigger.zh: 柏Q实际就绪、目标可命中，需要补燃点或火积蓄。
trigger.en: Burnice’s own Ultimate is ready and useful for Heat/Fire buildup against a hittable target.

complete.zh: 发动恢复50燃点；响应快支后柏会延长喷射，下一步由派派接手。
complete.en: Activation restores 50 Heat; responding to Quick Assist extends Burnice’s spray while Piper takes control next.

reason.zh: 这是固定技能明确允许的续喷合轴，不把普通切人当作快支。
reason.en: The fixed skill explicitly permits continuing spray through this assist; a normal switch is not the same trigger.

fallback.zh: 柏Q未就绪就用常态补火路线，普通切派派并跳过下一步快支；不假定共享喧响。
fallback.en: If unavailable, use regular Fire setup, switch normally to Piper and skip the next assist event. Decibels are not shared.

signal.zh: 仅响应跳起时真实出现的派派快支。
signal.en: Respond only to the actual Piper Quick Assist during Burnice’s leap.

title.zh: 派派快支接手，柏继续喷射
title.en: Piper takes Quick Assist while Burnice keeps spraying

input.zh: 按实际派派快支提示接手；完成支援攻击后再进行后续操作。
input.en: Take the actual Piper Quick Assist prompt and finish its attack before the next action.

trigger.zh: 柏Q产生的提示确实存在，循环站位凯撒→柏→派。
trigger.en: Burnice’s actual Ultimate prompt exists; cyclic order is Caesar→Burnice→Piper.

complete.zh: 派派完成刹车急停，柏仍喷射的实际部分与派派动作重叠。
complete.en: Piper finishes Brake Tap; only the portion where Burnice is still spraying overlaps Piper’s actions.

reason.zh: 支援不直接让轮胎转满蓄，也不直接提供20动力。
reason.en: This assist does not directly max Tire Spin charge or grant 20 Power.

fallback.zh: 没提示就普通切入并跳过本招；已结束的柏Q不能继续计作重叠。
fallback.en: Without the prompt, switch normally and skip this move; do not count an already finished Burnice Ultimate as overlap.

label.zh: 终结技实际仍在续喷时的重叠
label.en: Overlap only while the Ultimate actually continues spraying

title.zh: 派派自己的Q按窗口使用
title.en: Spend Piper’s own ready Ultimate in the window

input.zh: 派派Q实际就绪且有合适窗口时释放；否则直接走下一步EX准备。
input.en: Use Piper’s own Ultimate when ready with a useful opening; otherwise proceed to EX preparation.

trigger.zh: 独立喧响已够，目标可命中；不是柏用Q后派派必然也能用。
trigger.en: Her independent Decibels suffice and the target is hittable; Burnice using an Ultimate does not guarantee Piper can.

complete.zh: 旋转部分命中叠动力，随后下砸；按真实强击与紊乱结算。
complete.en: Spin hits build Power before the slam; count only actual Assault/Disorder procs.

reason.zh: 当前独立喧响替代作者旧版共享大招分配，不锁死只给一人开大。
reason.en: Current independent Decibels replace the old article’s shared-Ultimate allocation.

fallback.zh: Q未就绪省略；不要停场等满，继续有能量的轮胎转→引擎转。
fallback.en: Skip if unready; continue an affordable Tire Spin→Engine Spin rather than waiting idle.

label.zh: 余烬 · 燃油特调仍在、有燃点且队友实际命中灼伤目标时触发
label.en: Afterburn · requires Nitro-Fuel, Heat and an ally hitting a Scorched target

label.zh: 荣光之盾 · 攻击增益给当前护盾持有者，按实际盾量与持续时间
label.en: Radiant Aegis · ATK buff follows the current shield holder; check actual shield and duration

title.zh: 先让轮胎转达到最高蓄力
title.en: Bring Tire Spin to maximum charge first

input.zh: 先打普攻前三段中的合法衔接段，再长按特殊技；观察旋转蓄力提升。
input.en: Use a legal link after one of the first three Basic stages, then hold Special and observe the spin charge.

trigger.zh: 派派已在前场，准备发动引擎转；不把快支或连携当作满蓄力入口。
trigger.en: Piper is active and preparing Engine Spin; Quick Assist or Chain alone is not a maximum-charge entry.

complete.zh: 轮胎转达到最高蓄力且能量足够，才继续按住转EX。
complete.en: Only continue into EX once Tire Spin is at maximum charge and energy is sufficient.

reason.zh: 普攻衔接提高起始蓄力，但不是每段都瞬间满；0影普通轮胎转不按核心直接叠动力。
reason.en: The Basic link raises starting charge, but does not make every stage instantly maximum. At M0, normal Tire Spin does not grant core Power stacks.

fallback.zh: 无能量先普攻回能，危险时松手／闪避；不要把普通转圈算作EX或免伤无敌。
fallback.en: Without energy, recover with Basics. Release/dodge danger; normal spinning is neither EX nor full invulnerability.

label.zh: 余烬 · 燃油特调仍在、有燃点且队友实际命中灼伤目标时触发
label.en: Afterburn · requires Nitro-Fuel, Heat and an ally hitting a Scorched target

label.zh: 荣光之盾 · 攻击增益给当前护盾持有者，按实际盾量与持续时间
label.en: Radiant Aegis · ATK buff follows the current shield holder; check actual shield and duration

title.en: Land Engine Spin and read Power

input.zh: 轮胎转最高蓄力且能量足够时继续长按EX，贴住可命中的目标。
input.en: At maximum Tire Spin charge with enough energy, keep holding EX against a hittable target.

trigger.zh: 合法满蓄入口、实有能量、目标处于攻击范围。
trigger.en: A legal full-charge entry, real energy and a target in reach.

complete.zh: EX旋转命中逐次叠动力；达到20才有本队团队增伤，灼烧目标上触发强击才按实际结算紊乱。
complete.en: EX spin hits build Power; the team buff needs 20 stacks. Assault on a Burning target resolves the actual Disorder.

reason.zh: 旋转持续耗能，基础上限3秒，6影才延长；不能把每次旋转都算一轮强击。
reason.en: Spinning spends energy continuously, with a baseline three-second cap extended only at M6; each spin is not automatically an Assault.

fallback.zh: 火底不在就看当前异常继续积蓄或回柏补火；能量不足提前收尾，别硬等满时长。
fallback.en: If Burn is absent, work from the current Anomaly or restore Fire with Burnice. Finish early when energy is low.

label.zh: 余烬 · 燃油特调仍在、有燃点且队友实际命中灼伤目标时触发
label.en: Afterburn · requires Nitro-Fuel, Heat and an ally hitting a Scorched target

label.zh: 荣光之盾 · 攻击增益给当前护盾持有者，按实际盾量与持续时间
label.en: Radiant Aegis · ATK buff follows the current shield holder; check actual shield and duration

title.zh: 松开EX收下砸，决定是否回补
title.en: Release EX for the slam, then assess recovery

input.zh: 引擎转中松开EX；时长到顶或能量降至20也会自动发动。
input.en: Release EX during Engine Spin; it also triggers automatically at its time limit or when energy drops to 20.

trigger.zh: 已经处于引擎转；普通轮胎转松手是另一招。
trigger.en: Engine Spin is active; releasing normal Tire Spin is a different move.

complete.zh: 确认非常重下砸完成，读取剩余动力、能量、燃点与盾。
complete.en: Confirm Really Heavy finishes, then read Power, energy, Heat and the shield.

reason.zh: 有资源继续派派；燃点或盾不足才切辅助，避免固定循环挤掉可用输出。
reason.en: Stay on Piper while resources last; only refresh missing Heat/shield rather than forcing unnecessary swaps.

fallback.zh: 已经自动下砸不要重复输入；若只有普通轮胎转，按普通收尾处理后重新准备EX。
fallback.en: Do not repeat an already automatic slam. If only normal Tire Spin was active, finish it normally and prepare EX again.

label.zh: 余烬 · 燃油特调仍在、有燃点且队友实际命中灼伤目标时触发
label.en: Afterburn · requires Nitro-Fuel, Heat and an ally hitting a Scorched target

label.zh: 荣光之盾 · 攻击增益给当前护盾持有者，按实际盾量与持续时间
label.en: Radiant Aegis · ATK buff follows the current shield holder; check actual shield and duration

prep.zh: 盾和燃点／标记在窗口前处理；两人的Q各看自己的喧响。
prep.en: Prepare shield/Heat/mark before the window; check each character’s own Decibels.

text.zh: 派派1把动力上限改30，普通／EX／Q旋转命中有概率额外加层；不是每下必加额外层。
text.en: Piper M1 raises the Power cap to 30 and gives spin hits a chance of an additional stack, not a guaranteed extra stack per hit.

text.zh: 派派4全队实际施加异常可回能，30秒间隔；不能每次转圈都赠送能量。
text.en: Piper M4 restores energy on an actual squad-applied Anomaly with a 30s cooldown, not on every spin.

text.zh: 派派6引擎转时长上限加2秒、动力持续加4秒；依然持续耗能，能量不足要提前收尾。
text.en: Piper M6 adds two seconds to Engine Spin’s cap and four to Power duration; energy is still continuously spent, so finish early when short.

text.zh: 轰鸣座驾EX命中随机触发三种增益之一；按实际出现与持续时间，不把一次命中算三种全满。
text.en: Roaring Ride randomly triggers one of three buffs on an EX hit; read actual effects/duration rather than granting all three from one hit.

text.zh: 凯撒1接战入场可直接供盾但有300秒间隔；当前盾足够可省略补盾EX，仍不保证易伤已经挂好。
text.en: Caesar M1 combat entry can grant a shield with a 300s cooldown; skip redundant EX when sufficient, without assuming the separate debuff is active.

text.zh: 柏1提高燃点上限和开战燃点；退出特调后仍须达到50燃点重新激活。
text.en: Burnice M1 increases Heat cap/starting Heat; reactivation after Nitro-Fuel ends still requires 50 Heat.

text.zh: 柏6双喷可触发不耗燃点的特殊余烬；与队友触发的普通余烬分开。火焰冲击结算灼烧还需目标在灼烧且同目标20秒间隔。
text.en: Burnice M6 double-nozzle adds Heat-free special Afterburn, separate from ally-triggered normal Afterburn. Its fire-blast Burn resolution still needs Burn and a 20s per-target cooldown.

text.zh: 柏专武叠层依靠EX／支援攻击命中，后台叠层效率翻倍；不能仅因为退场就视为满层。
text.en: Burnice’s signature stacks through EX/Assist hits, with doubled stacking off-field; merely leaving the field does not max it.

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.有需要才接双喷，然后交派派: 长按普攻收尾后按强化特殊技双喷
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.先让轮胎转达到最高蓄力: 普攻后长按特殊技蓄满旋转
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.引擎转命中，读取动力: 蓄满后继续长按特殊技
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.补燃点并重挂灼伤: 点按或长按强化特殊技补燃点
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.柏Q就绪时打开双人输出窗口: 柏妮思终结技就绪时开，等派派快支
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.派派快支接手，柏继续喷射: 看到派派快支提示再入场
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.派派自己的Q按窗口使用: 派派自己的终结技就绪才用

ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.长普终结一击后，有能量点按EX接双喷；按需要保持长按。: 长按普攻的最后一击结束、能量够时，点按强化特殊技接双喷；需要延长再保持长按。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.先打普攻前三段中的合法衔接段，再长按特殊技；观察旋转蓄力提升。: 先打普攻前三段中能衔接的段数，再长按特殊技；观察旋转是否蓄到最高。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.轮胎转最高蓄力且能量足够时继续长按EX，贴住可命中的目标。: 旋转蓄满且能量够时，继续长按特殊技键启动强化旋转，并贴近目标。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.引擎转中松开EX；时长到顶或能量降至20也会自动发动。: 强化旋转中松开特殊技键下砸；持续时间到顶或能量降至20时也会自动收招。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.普通切柏；她自己的Q就绪时释放，跳起出现派派快支提示再响应。: 柏妮思普通入场后，自己的终结技就绪时按终结技；跃起并出现派派快支提示后再按支援键。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.派派Q实际就绪且有合适窗口时释放；否则直接走下一步EX准备。: 派派自己的终结技就绪且窗口合适时按终结技，否则跳过，转下一步准备强化特殊技。

ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1171: 燃点不够且有能量时按强化特殊技单喷；已处于燃油特调则可长按普攻。
ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1281: 点普攻打到前三段中的可衔接段，再长按特殊技蓄旋转；蓄满且能量足才继续长按。

ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.117100014: 终结技就绪时点按终结技，完成本次喷射

107100002: 本步要长按普攻打重击，没有先点普攻到某一段的要求。
Hold Basic for the heavy strike. No preceding Basic hit number is required.
117100002: 燃油特调期间长按普攻；若用此动作接双喷，等长按普攻的终结一击发动，再按强化特殊技。
Hold Basic in Nitro-Fuel Cocktail. To link this move into the double shot, wait for its finishing hit to begin, then press EX.
117100007: 双喷前的普攻不是必打：可接在燃油特调长按普攻的终结一击之后，或在单喷中直接按强化特殊技；两条路都要有能量。
Basic is optional before the double shot: link EX after the held Basic finisher in Nitro-Fuel Cocktail, or directly during the single shot, with sufficient Energy.
128100004: 继续按住特殊技转强化的条件是旋转已经满蓄且能量够；普攻只影响上一招起转速度，不是这里的必按键。
Keep holding to enter EX only at full spin charge and sufficient Energy. Basic affects the spin opener, not this activation.

1171: 已在燃油特调时才可改用长按普攻；普攻不是强化特殊技单喷的前置。
The held Basic is a recovery option in Nitro-Fuel Cocktail, not a prerequisite for the EX single shot.
